name: normative_statement
description: A single atomic normative requirement, expressed using RFC 2119 keywords.

aiGuidance.purpose: Exactly one atomic, testable requirement, stated with an RFC 2119 keyword. This is the field conformance is read from.
aiGuidance.extraction: One sentence, one requirement, one keyword: MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT, or MAY. Name the actor and the observable condition so that a conformance test follows from this sentence alone, with no surrounding context: "A Record MUST resolve its typeId and typeVersion against the effective package set." Keep the reasoning out — it belongs in `rationale`. Keep illustrations out — they belong in an `example` record.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: No two requirements joined by "and" — split them into two records so each can be tested and cited separately. No rationale, no examples, no headings, no code blocks, no tables. Do not restate a requirement another record already makes; relate the records (`refines`, `supersedes`) instead. Avoid lower-case "should" or "may" as ordinary English here — in this field every such word reads as a keyword.
